project_lifecycle.reason: No active ContextOS increment is currently authorized. Routine reconciliation was consuming HELIX governed-agent cycles without an active decision, implementation, deployment, or dependency gate.
project_lifecycle.resume_gate: Resume only after Anthony Edgar explicitly authorizes a new bounded ContextOS objective with a fresh branch, declared file scope, verification criteria, and pull request.

resolution_rules.current_default_branch_head: Resolve from live GitHub metadata only when an allowed targeted observation is triggered.
resolution_rules.pull_request_state: Open or changing pull requests do not reactivate an on-hold project. Resolve them only during an explicit ContextOS review or approved dependency-impact check.
resolution_rules.ci_and_reviews: Use exact-head GitHub workflow and review metadata for the relevant commit. A synthetic merge ref is not exact-head evidence.
resolution_rules.deployment_state: Resolve from evidence produced on a selected host. Repository readiness does not prove installation, runtime health, or operational use.
resolution_rules.temporary_write_authority: No ContextOS repository write authority is active while the project is on hold. A new grant must be explicit, branch-bound, scope-bound, and non-inheriting.
resolution_rules.reconciliation_eligibility: Skip routine, scheduled, and open-pull-request reconciliation while project_lifecycle.status is on_hold.
